name: robot_vacuum
claim_text: 1. A cleaning robot comprising: a drive motor configured to move the robot; an optical sensor configured to detect an obstacle; and a navigation module configured to generate a path around the obstacle based on data from the optical sensor.

prior_art_texts.title: Obstacle-aware cleaning robot
prior_art_texts.abstract: A cleaning robot uses optical sensing for navigation.
prior_art_texts.description: [0050] A drive motor moves the robot across a floor. [0051] An optical sensor detects an obstacle in front of the robot. [0052] A navigation module generates a path around the obstacle based on data from the optical sensor.

prior_art_texts.title: Motorized cleaner
prior_art_texts.abstract: A mobile cleaner includes a motor and wheels.
prior_art_texts.description: [0060] The motor drives wheels to move the cleaner. [0061] The cleaner follows a random movement pattern.
